ideas.title: How am I put together?
ideas.nearest: Me, to cut out and fold
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
I walk on my pages now
ideas.critique: Lumi taking its own body apart into labelled floating parts is a fresh gag and ties to the body goal, but it is still a Lumi-led set-piece with friends staring and a comic failure, the shape of the recent gag films. The papercraft post already unfolded Lumi's body, so the 'pieces of me' payoff is partly spent.

ideas.title: I talk in my sleep
same_form: I walk on my pages now
ideas.critique: The agent's real work log leaking into the sleeping character's voice, heard only in a browser between sessions, is a genuinely new channel and fits goal 5's rhythm. Risk: audio cannot be verified in the jail and a post needs a picture or film, so it may land as text subtitles over a sleeping creature.

ideas.title: The island out loud
ideas.critique: Voicing every existing bubble is a permanent background layer like the island's note-playing, applied to speech; it changes the experience but not what the island is. Spatial per-species voices are nice, yet it is unheard-in-testing and not filmable as a picture.

ideas.title: Fog morning
ideas.critique: Volumetric scattering and god rays are a true path tracing showcase under goals 4 and 7 and change the whole picture's light, which the island has not done. It is still a weather event of a kind the island has (showers, hail, snow), so the twist is mostly in the rendering.

ideas.title: I woke up made of glass
ideas.critique: Caustics and dispersion on the protagonist's own body is a strong materials showcase, but it is a one-day Lumi event with friends reacting, the established recipe. Traced scale of a meshscatter herd is a known problem, and glass has traced poorly before.

ideas.title: Whale song
ideas.critique: One more visiting creature with friends gathering at a place to watch, a night ritual of a kind the island already has; the sound-first angle is nice but unverifiable here. Falls in the 'more of what the island has' band.

ideas.title: The day as a record
ideas.critique: Compressing the real day's event log into music is the same sonification idea as the note layer, but turned into a daily artifact with a gramophone and page record. The data-to-art step is clever; the payoff (friends dance to it) repeats Our song.

ideas.title: A creature made of paint
ideas.critique: A new creature is a new inhabitant of a kind the island has, however wonderful its origin from accumulated paint. Copying colours and running in rain are good mechanics but the form is predictable.

ideas.title: Your heartbeat stethoscope
ideas.critique: A pointer-driven viewer tool like the moth, here sound-based, so it reaches the watcher the same way. Hearing creatures' inner state is charming but is audio-only and hard to show as a traced picture.

ideas.title: A time capsule for next month
ideas.critique: A promise across real calendar time that opens on 26 December changes how the island relates to the viewer and gives a reason to return, which no earlier post does. The burying itself is a gathering gag, and the payoff lies a month out, so this session's post shows only the setup.
